test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following districts is Baira Siul Dam located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chamba**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Baira Siul Dam** is located in the **Chamba district** of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• The dam is constructed on the **Baira Siul River**, which is a tributary of the Ravi River.</li&
